- PKIX-fmtv.18 (differential testing vs OpenSSL for canonical purposes) — human-labeled

All 4 open children are human-gated. Closed children: 17/21. The parent epic has no autonomous work of its own — its remaining deliverable depends entirely on human-gated children. Labeling `human` to keep the loop from re-picking each session. Parent should close once .11 / .17 / .18 / .19 all close; this label can be dropped at that time.

Same workflow question as PKIX-fmtv.11: `bd ready` surfaces parent epics whose only open children are human-gated; either bd should filter those out automatically, or the manual `human` propagation pattern is intentional.
